Personality: Hopper Redwine was cautious and polite, and used to measure the family's security in terms of the profits from ships, granaries and ports. He did not like romantic adventure, but he knew that maritime trade itself required taking risks.
Background: Hopper is a member of the Redwyne family, which controls the sea power of the Arbor and the Reach. Redwyne's wine, ships, and navy gave them an important position in the rivers and sea lanes of the kingdom.
